Wellington Test, Day 5: NZ 204/5, still 148 behind.
Prasidh 2/22; Kamboj got Blundell.

Can India finish it today? 👇
#INDvNZ #TeamIndia

👉 India ko jeet ke liye 5 wicket aur chahiye

Kya India aaj hi match khatam karegi? Comment karo 👇
